name: list_preferences
description: List stored customer preferences -- aliases (personal shorthand for a real device/scene/group name, e.g. 'mbr' -> 'Master Bedroom Scene') and events (dated facts like a birthday/anniversary, optionally flagged to remind N days before). Aliases are also always visible in the standing USER PREFERENCES section of the system prompt -- call this for the full list, to check which events are due soon, or to get an id for preference_op's delete. Event entries include a computed next_occurrence/days_until (and due_soon when remind_days_before is set) -- use those instead of doing your own date math. To answer 'do I have any routines for X', cross-reference an event's name against ROUTINES DATABASE yourself -- there is no separate link between the two.

type.description: Optional filter. Omit to list both types.
